name: EMA20 reclaim, then RSI crosses 50
hypothesis: EXAMPLE rule, written to exercise the engine. Expectation stated before any run: a close back above EMA20, followed within 5 bars by RSI(14) crossing above 50, while price holds above SMA50, beats the random-entry baseline at 20 sessions on NIFTY 500 daily bars. Prior: weak or none - this is a generic momentum-reclaim entry.
